name: GhostCall
description: Trustless 1:1 audio calls on Starknet. Tor onion transport, Noise_XX encryption, Nostr signaling, STRK20 shielded payments. No IP leaks. No TURN servers.
problem: Every existing calling app leaks your IP to the counterparty or to a relay. Web3 calling apps add on-chain payments but still route audio through centralized TURN servers.
solution: GhostCall routes every call through a Tor v3 onion service — no TURN, no IP exposure. Noise_XX encrypts the audio stream end-to-end. Nostr NIP-59 gift-wraps the call signal. Post-call payments settle privately via STRK20.
diagram:
graph LR
  A[Caller] -->|Nostr NIP-59 gift-wrap| B[Relay]
  B -->|signal| C[Callee]
  A -->|Tor Noise_XX audio| D[Onion service]
  D --> C
  C -->|STRK20 shielded payment| E[Pool]
  E -->|private note| A
